# Stethos

> Real-time data API for US healthcare providers and organizations, built for AI agents. Search clinicians and organizations, enrich a record from an NPI, and subscribe to change events by webhook or MCP. Provider data only, no patient data.

## Pages
- [Home](https://stethos.vercel.app/): what Stethos does and who it's for
- [Use cases](https://stethos.vercel.app/use-cases): medtech and pharma sales, provider directories, clinical staffing, investors, digital health
- [Medtech and pharma sales](https://stethos.vercel.app/use-cases/medtech-pharma): Find surgeons and physicians by specialty, procedure focus, affiliation and license, and get alerts when targets move. A provider data API for sales agents.
- [Provider directories and networks](https://stethos.vercel.app/use-cases/provider-directories): Check provider directory listings against current sources. Flag stale locations, lapsed licenses and network mismatches with a real-time provider data API.
- [Clinical staffing and recruiting](https://stethos.vercel.app/use-cases/clinical-staffing): Source licensed clinicians by state and specialty, and spot health systems that are hiring. A real-time clinician data API for staffing platforms.
- [Healthcare investors](https://stethos.vercel.app/use-cases/investors): Track practice roll-ups, clinician headcount and new locations as they happen. Real-time healthcare organization data for investors and corporate development.
- [Digital health and AI apps](https://stethos.vercel.app/use-cases/digital-health): Power provider search, referrals and scheduling in your app with one NPI-keyed API, and let AI agents look up any clinician over MCP.
- [Docs](https://stethos.vercel.app/docs): quickstart for search, enrich, organizations, watchers and MCP (preview)
- [NPI lookup API](https://stethos.vercel.app/npi-lookup-api): Look up any NPI and get more than the registry: licenses, affiliations, payer networks and practice contacts, each with a source and verified date.
- [Physician data API](https://stethos.vercel.app/physician-data-api): A physician data API with specialties, affiliations, state licenses and practice contacts for every US physician, plus webhooks when physicians move.
- [License data API](https://stethos.vercel.app/license-verification-api): Check physician and nurse license status across states in one API call, and get a webhook when a license is issued, expires or is restricted.
- [Health system data API](https://stethos.vercel.app/health-system-data-api): Health systems, hospitals, groups and clinics in one API: locations, rostered clinicians, leadership, open roles and ownership, with change alerts.
- [Pricing](https://stethos.vercel.app/pricing): credit-based pricing, Free, Build and Enterprise
- [Stethos vs Definitive Healthcare](https://stethos.vercel.app/compare/definitive-healthcare)
- [Stethos vs IQVIA OneKey](https://stethos.vercel.app/compare/iqvia-onekey)

## Guides
- [What the NPI registry can and can't tell you](https://stethos.vercel.app/blog/what-the-npi-registry-can-and-cant-tell-you): The NPPES NPI Registry is the backbone of US provider data. Here's what it reliably tells you, where it falls short, and what to pair it with.
- [Why provider directories go stale, and what keeps them current](https://stethos.vercel.app/blog/why-provider-directories-go-stale): Provider directories drift out of date because clinicians move faster than the systems that track them. Here's where the errors come from and what helps.
- [Giving an AI agent healthcare data: a checklist](https://stethos.vercel.app/blog/giving-an-ai-agent-healthcare-data-checklist): Before an AI agent acts on healthcare provider data, check freshness, provenance, identifiers, cost controls and patient privacy. A short checklist.
